title: Kixie Pricing in 2026: Plans, Add-Ons and Alternatives
summary: Kixie doesn't publish per-seat prices: its three plans are quoted per team, with a 7-day free trial. See the charges Kixie does publish and priced alternatives.
body_markdown:
Kixie does not publish per-seat prices. Its pricing page lists three plans, Professional, Single-Line PowerDialer and Multi-Line PowerDialer, with no dollar amounts, and Kixie says prices are quoted per team. Every plan has a 7-day free trial with no credit card. No seat minimum is stated. The pages were read on November 11, 2026.


Trellus publishes this guide and sells a competing dialer. Every Kixie detail below comes from Kixie's own pricing page and help centre, opened on November 11, 2026. No price here comes from a review site, and no paid Kixie account was used. For a feature-by-feature view, see[Trellus vs. Kixie](https://www.trellus.ai/compare/trellus-vs-kixie) .


## Kixie pricing at a glance


Kixie's[pricing page](https://www.kixie.com/pricing/) shows what each plan includes but not what it costs. Its[facts page](https://www.kixie.com/llm-info/) states that per-seat prices are not published and are quoted per team.

The billing-terms wording comes from Kixie's[billing article](https://support.kixie.com/hc/en-us/articles/225116528-How-does-Kixie-s-billing-work) . It says payment terms differ by team size and plan, and it sends buyers to sales for the details.


## What changes the real cost of Kixie


The seat price comes from a quote. Kixie's help centre does publish several charges that sit on top of it.


### Minutes and the reserve balance


The pricing page lists unlimited minutes for US and Canada calls on all three plans. Kixie's[unlimited minutes article](https://support.kixie.com/hc/en-us/articles/360051313714-How-does-Kixie-s-Unlimited-Minutes-Dialing-Plan-Work) adds a limit: calls that cost more than $0.02 a minute are not covered. Its examples include incoming calls to toll-free numbers and some remote areas of Alaska and Hawaii.


Those calls, and outbound text messages, are paid from a prepaid reserve. The[reserve article](https://support.kixie.com/hc/en-us/articles/4406482679835-What-is-the-Minutes-Reserve-Charge) says Kixie invoices a $50 reserve charge when a card is first submitted and recharges it when the balance falls below $50. Inbound texts are free.


A per-minute option also exists. The same article says per-minute users get their first 300 standard-rate minutes free. The billing article says an account that adds a card without choosing a plan defaults to the Professional pay-per-minute plan.


### Phone numbers


Kixie's[number purchase guide](https://support.kixie.com/hc/en-us/articles/18813083475739-Purchasing-a-New-Phone-Number-for-an-Agent) says each agent's first number is included and each extra number costs $5 a month. That guide was last updated in November 2023. International and toll-free numbers are ordered through support.


### Add-ons


- **Do Not Call check:** $20 a month per user, on the Professional plan, per the[DNC add-on article](https://support.kixie.com/hc/en-us/articles/16376376568859-DNC-Algorithm-for-Calls-SMS) .
- **ConnectionBoost:** an add-on for Professional tier users. The[ConnectionBoost article](https://support.kixie.com/hc/en-us/articles/360057490914-What-is-Kixie-ConnectionBoost) sends buyers to sales for the price. A[follow-up guide](https://support.kixie.com/hc/en-us/articles/34120536779803-Taking-ConnectionBoost-to-the-Next-Level) lists its Number Health Reputation Manager at $1 a month per number plus $50 a month per ConnectionBoost user.
- **Conversation Intelligence and AI Human Voice Detection:** listed as premium add-ons. No price is published.


### Contract length and seat changes


Kixie's billing article says there are no setup fees and no refunds once a subscription charge goes through. Adding a user triggers a prorated charge straight away. The[cancellation article](https://support.kixie.com/hc/en-us/articles/57012709370651-How-to-Cancel-Your-Kixie-Account) says a standard account has no minimum term.


Contract accounts work differently. The[annual contracts article](https://support.kixie.com/hc/en-us/articles/5534691005723-Kixie-Billing-Annual-Contracts-and-Annual-Bill-Cycles) says user licenses can be downgraded or removed only in the last 30 days of the term. On an annual bill cycle, Kixie gives no refund or credit for removing or downgrading users.


Cancelling takes two steps: an email to support and an exit survey. Kixie says billing continues until the survey is completed.


### What to ask for in the quote


Ask Kixie for the seat price of each plan on monthly and annual terms. Ask for the price of every add-on you plan to use and how many numbers each rep will need. Then ask what happens to the price if you add or remove seats before the term ends.


## Who Kixie fits and who it does not


Kixie's pages describe a sales phone system with a dialer inside it. All three plans list IVR, ring groups, call queues, call recording and text messaging. That fits a team that takes inbound calls, sends texts and dials lists from the same tool.


It also fits a team that wants to test before it talks price. The trial runs 7 days and needs no card, and Kixie's[trial article](https://support.kixie.com/hc/en-us/articles/360046327754-Questions-about-the-Kixie-Free-Trial-or-Demo) says more agents can be added to it.


Kixie is a weaker fit for a buyer who has to set a budget from a public price list. Seat prices and most add-on prices need a sales conversation. It is also not the match for a team that wants more than four lines, since the Multi-Line PowerDialer lists up to 4.


A team that only needs list dialing inside its CRM should check which phone-system features it would use before comparing quotes. Ask for the price of the plan and dialing mode the reps will run, with the add-ons you need written into the quote.

## Frequently asked questions


### How much does Kixie cost per user?


Kixie does not publish a per-user price. Its pricing page lists the Professional, Single-Line PowerDialer and Multi-Line PowerDialer plans without dollar amounts, and its facts page says prices are quoted per team. Published extras include $5 a month for each additional phone number and $20 a month per user for the Do Not Call check.


### Does Kixie have a free trial?


Yes. Kixie's pricing page offers a 7-day free trial with no credit card required. Its cancellation article says trial accounts have no card on file, so there is nothing to cancel and no charge at the end. The trial article says more agents can be added during the trial through a salesperson.


### Does Kixie require an annual contract?


Not always. Kixie's cancellation article says a standard account has no minimum term and can be cancelled at any time. Accounts that signed a contract can remove or downgrade user licenses only in the last 30 days of the term. Charges already taken are not refunded in either case.


### Are minutes included in Kixie plans?


Kixie's pricing page lists unlimited minutes for US and Canada calls on all three plans. Its help centre says calls costing more than $0.02 a minute are not covered and are paid from a prepaid reserve. That reserve starts with a $50 charge and is topped up when it falls below $50.


### Which Kixie alternatives publish their prices?


On November 11, 2026, Trellus listed Power at $99.99 and Power + Parallel at $149.99 per seat a month. WAVV listed $99 and $149 billed monthly. PhoneBurner started at $165 billed monthly or $140 billed annually. Salesfinity Gold was $299 month to month or $249 billed annually.
